configuration.cancellation_method: two protocol-compliant batches of 50 pipelined cancel_job requests against active BitBake jobs; every request receives an ordered correlated command_result and each batch proves at least one accepted live-supervisor cancellation
configuration.command_method: client cancel_job for a deliberately absent u64 job identity through daemon dispatch to correlated not_found command_result receipt; measured round trip is a conservative upper bound on daemon receipt without command workload
configuration.load: one pinned worker per affinity CPU; no deliberately free CPU
